metric_definitions.business_question: How quickly are new business-hours Sales leads receiving their first response (median)?
metric_definitions.population: Serra Honda 21043 Sales leads, period 2026-08-24..2026-08-30, Originated After Hours == No (business-hours-originated)
metric_definitions.formula: median(Actual Response Time (Min) where Originated After Hours == No, numeric only); blanks stay missing and are excluded (missing is not zero)
metric_definitions.explainability_ref: Median first-response minutes for business-hours leads; blanks excluded (never zero). Graded against the approved OT-SW-011 ceiling (>10 min = breach).
metric_definitions.evidence_index_ref: PKT-02-01 supporting-data index: Actual Response Time distribution, business-hours filter, coverage/missing footnote

metric_definitions.business_question: What is the strict-untouched rate: business-hours leads with NO first contact attempt AND NO first customer contact AND NO actual response time?
metric_definitions.population: Serra Honda 21043 Sales leads, period 2026-08-24..2026-08-30, Originated After Hours == No (business-hours population)
metric_definitions.numerator: count of business-hours leads where First Contact Attempt is blank AND First Customer Contact is blank AND Actual Response Time (Min) is blank (strict AND across all three; every source period ended before capture so each qualifying row has aged > 30 minutes)
metric_definitions.formula: count(First Contact Attempt blank AND First Customer Contact blank AND Actual Response Time blank where Originated After Hours == No) / business_hours_population
metric_definitions.evidence_ref: accepted+evaluated (gate2-evaluator-contract.json SW-012 leads.untouched_strict_rate; gate5b-report-model-21043.json); ended-period >30min proof
metric_definitions.explainability_ref: Strict-untouched rate: only leads blank on ALL THREE contact/response fields (never ANY/OR); aged >30 min; graded against zero-tolerance OT-SW-012 (>0 = breach).
metric_definitions.evidence_index_ref: PKT-02-01 supporting-data index: strict-untouched count, business-hours denominator, aged-row proof

metric_definitions.business_question: Do AFTER-HOURS-originated leads receive a first HUMAN response by the authoritative next opening + 15 minutes?
metric_definitions.population: Serra Honda 21043 AFTER-HOURS-originated Sales leads (Originated After Hours == Yes) with no HUMAN response by the authoritative next opening + 15 minutes
metric_definitions.evidence_ref: Held open: an AUTHORITATIVE opening schedule and a first-HUMAN response timestamp are NOT present in the current Leads source; NO proxy from generic hours or Adjusted Response Time.
metric_definitions.next_action: finite investigation: one help-contract pass + one read-only UI discovery pass + one controlled probe to prove a direct opening schedule and first-human timestamp (no Vin/UI action performed in this authoring step)
metric_definitions.explainability_ref: After-hours SLA: first human response by next opening + 15 min. Held open — opening boundary + first-human timestamp absent; no proxy.

metric_definitions.business_question: How many Sales leads received an AUTO-REPLY-ONLY first response with NO human touch within two hours?
metric_definitions.population: Serra Honda 21043 Sales leads (no business-hours restriction) whose first response was auto-reply only AND had no human touch within two hours
metric_definitions.evidence_ref: Held open: a direct actor classification (auto-reply vs human) with timestamps is NOT present in the current Leads source; NO inference from channel or direction. Event predicate: first response auto-reply only AND no human touch within two hours (no business-hours restriction).
metric_definitions.next_action: finite investigation: one help-contract pass + one read-only UI discovery pass + one controlled probe to prove a direct auto-vs-human actor classification + timestamps (no Vin/UI action performed in this authoring step)
metric_definitions.explainability_ref: Auto-reply-only event predicate (auto-reply first AND no human touch within 2h); count, not duration; no business-hours restriction. Held open — direct actor classification absent; no channel/direction proxy.

metric_definitions.business_question: What share of Sales reps have a mean first-response at least 2x the store median (business-hours population)?
metric_definitions.population: Serra Honda 21043 Sales leads, period 2026-08-24..2026-08-30, Originated After Hours == No (SW-011 business-hours population), grouped by Sales Rep (pseudonymized, ephemeral)
metric_definitions.numerator: count of Sales Reps whose mean Actual Response Time (Min) >= 2 x the store median (store median = SW-011 business-hours population median)
metric_definitions.denominator: reps_with_numeric_response (Sales Reps with at least one numeric Actual Response Time)
metric_definitions.formula: count(rep mean Actual Response Time (Min) >= 2 x store median) / reps_with_numeric_response
metric_definitions.explainability_ref: Share of reps whose mean response is at least 2x the store median (NOT a minutes difference). Sales Rep aggregated in-memory and pseudonymized to an ephemeral tenant id, NEVER persisted as a name; customer/VIN/body excluded. Graded against zero-tolerance OT-SW-015 (>0 = breach).
metric_definitions.evidence_index_ref: PKT-02-01 supporting-data index: per-rep response vs store median (pseudonymized), triggered-rep count/share

comparison_reference_contract.formula: store median as internal comparison (SW-011 population)

grade_target_contract.value_or_range: > 0 (any rep >= 2x store median = breach); comparator '>' lower_is_better
